faq.q: Should we build our own site if we are on the portals?
faq.a: Yes. Portals put you next to every competitor and own the relationship. Your own site is where you control presentation and keep the lead.

faq.q: Can our website pull listings automatically?
faq.a: Usually yes, if your CRM or portal exposes a feed or API. It is worth confirming before design begins, since it shapes the build.

faq.q: What matters most for property SEO?
faq.a: Area and development pages with genuinely useful local content, fast mobile performance, and structured data on listings so they can appear richly in results.
